same-server-authority-and-route-parity.summary: Chrome and the agent used the same local server. Focused checks passed for signed identity, workspace access, separate browser and agent permissions, and route and operation mapping.

postgres-atomicity-and-worker-delivery.summary: Both local workers received a committed change. After one worker stopped, its replacement and the surviving worker recovered the saved changes. Both live restricted-role database tests passed.

scope: These independently reviewed results apply to the local managed server and its isolated test database. Production deployment and scaling have separate qualification. Increment qualification remains open.
